// diagnostic

E0746

`{api}` has the `{effect}` effect, which can't be rolled back inside a `#Transact` block.

What

`{api}` has the `{effect}` effect, which can't be rolled back inside a `#Transact` block.

Why

A `#Transact` block undoes its work on a `?`-failure; network, file, subprocess, and foreign effects leave external state a rollback can't take back unless the foreign binding declares a compensating undo.

Fix

Move the call after the block, register it with `<handle>.on_commit(() -> { … })`, or declare `#Undo(inverse)` on the foreign binding.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0746: tests/ui/transact_ffi_undo_required.stderr.

Error [E0746]: `mutate` has the `FFI` effect, which can't be rolled back inside a `#Transact` block
  --> tests/ui/transact_ffi_undo_required.jet:7:9
    |
  7 |         mutate(1, 2)
    |         ^^^^^^
 Why: a foreign function can change external state that the compiler cannot undo automatically
 Fix: move this call after the block, or declare `#Undo(inverse)` on the foreign binding so rollback can call the inverse
